{{Quote|Birth occurs at the conjunction of pleasure and torment. So the first Forbidden Acts of the Forge birthed sparks of delight which took root in the Glory or in Nowhere: who can say? So the seeds of the Flowermaker were planted, though for long years he was nothing but an unfulfilled ache.|The Dark Gentleman, ''A Catalogue of Uncharted Pleasures''}}
'''The Flowermaker''', also called '''The Lilyking''', is one of the [[Hours]], associated with hour XIX, or 7:00pm. His [[Aspects]] are {{Lore|Grail}}, {{Lore|Lantern}}, and {{Lore|Moth}}. He is an offspring of [[The Forge of Days]]. The Flowermaker's sphere encompasses intense, self-destructive pleasure, ephemeral delights, and the transformative nature of joy and pain. It is said that The Flowermaker was birthed when The Forge of Days committed her "first Forbidden Acts". Whether these Forbidden Acts were tied to the shattering of [[The Flint]] or the division of [[the Sun-in-Splendour]] remains a subject of speculation, but they catalyzed the Flowermaker's emergence in either [[The Glory]] or [[Nowhere]].

==Notes==
*The Intercalate hypothesis of The Flowermaker's origin is backed by [[Devouring Mysteries]], which posits that the Flowermaker "came from light", possibly alluding to the creation of the Gods-from-Light during the Intercalate.
*The Flowermaker may share a mysterious bond with [[The Applebright]], speculated by some to be a counterpart birthed in [[Nowhere]].
*Among the Flowermaker's followers, a [[Names|Name]] known as Karpellus stands prominent.
*Regions like [[Sunshine Island]], [[Tirana]], [[The Pentapolis]], [[Granada]], and [[Paris]] resonate particularly with The Flowermaker's [[The Flowermaker's Shadow|influence]].
